### David’s Final Temple Guidance
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/davids-final-temple-guidance
Passage: 1 Chronicles 28:20-29:9
Points:
- David’s final instructions emphasize the crucial role of the temple in redemption history.
- Solomon is urged to act with courage because God will remain with him throughout the massive project.
- David’s charge encourages modern believers, knowing God is present as Christ builds His church.
- Believers are called to support kingdom work through the sacrificial giving of their resources and lives.
